title: The integer multiplicity cycle Z = (−1)^k ∂([[Q_r]] × Y) = [[Q_r]] × X + E′, supported in Q_r + spt Y
lean_statement: ∀ (P k m n' : ℕ) (g : Fin k → Euclid P) (h : n' = k + m) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) m) (Y : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) (m + 1)) (r : ℝ), 0 < k → 0 < m → Orthonormal ℝ g → IsIntegerMultiplicity X → IsIntegerMultiplicity Y → Y.boundary = X → IsCompact Y.support → Y.support ⊆ ((Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ : Set (Euclid P)) → 0 < r → ∃ Z E' : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n', IsIntegerMultiplicity Z ∧ BoundaryVanishes Z ∧ IsCompact Z.support ∧ Z.support ⊆ {x | ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) x| ≤ r} ∩ (Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g))ᗮ.starProjection ⁻¹' Y.support ∧ E'.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (2 * (k : ℝ) * (2 * r) ^ (k - 1)) * Y.mass ∧ ∀ flat : Covector (Euclid P) n' → Covector (Euclid P) m, (∀ (α : Covector (Euclid P) n') (v : Fin m → Euclid P), flat α v = α (Fin.append g v ∘ Fin.cast h)) → ∀ ω : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n', Z ω = (∫ t in {t | t ∈ Submodule.span ℝ (Set.range g) ∧ ∀ i, |inner ℝ (g i) t| ≤ r}, currentEval X (fun y => flat ((ω : DifferentialForm (Euclid P) n') (t + y))) ∂μHE[k]) + E' ω
